name: Tail Sprinters
summary: Hand-based motion controls for locomotion and object interaction. Photon PUN 2 handles real‑time network synchronization; PlayFab manages player accounts, inventories and cloud saves. Lobbies support up to 10 players with matchmaking and join‑by‑invite. Gem‑mining mode uses a pink cave environment with physics‑driven gem nodes and dynamic lighting.
